profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer / Designer with extensive experience crafting modern applications on top of resilient architectures for a multitude of clients; ranging from early stage Startups to Multinational Corporations.

Over my career, I've collaborated with a wide variety of teams as a contributor, leader, auditor, and advisor; utilizing broad technical expertise and effective communication to deliver products and meet client expectations.

▶︎ Production Experience

■ Language
TypeScript • JavaScript(ES5-Latest) • HTML5 • CSS(SASS, LESS, Stylus) • BASH • SQL • Python • PHP

■ Foundation
React-Native (Java, Kotlin, Obj-C, Swift) • ReactJS • Svelte • Angular(1.x - 2+) • ExpressJS • Serverless • Redux RxJS • NextJS • Polymer • Docker • Apache • Nginx • MongoDB • SQL • NoSQL • Flask  BackboneJS • Nuxeo

■ Workflow
Git • Webpack • BabelJS • GulpJS • Grunt • Browserify

■ CMS
CraftCMS • Jekyll • KeystoneJS • Wordpress • Contentful

■ Visual Library
D3.js • C3.js • ThreeJS • jQuery • VelocityJS • Processing.js

■ Service
AWS • Google App Engine • Azure • Digital Ocean • Vercel • Cloudflare • Google Analytics (GTM)

■ Design
• User Experience Design
• User Interface Design
• Market Research
• Information Architecture
• Graphic Design (PS, Sketch, AI)
• Motion Graphics (AE)
• 3D Generalist (Maya, 3dsMax)

And several many more!

positions.description: Built web applications for multinational corporations; developing on top of various architectures from the traditional frontend/backend stack to server-less architectures. Assisted other developers through troubleshooting, code review, performance auditing, mentoring, and by establishing best practices.
